### First checks
- [ ] I searched existing issues.
- [ ] This stays within scope (TerraFlow stops at creating a branch — see
      `docs/01-scope.md`).

### Describe the feature
What should TerraFlow support?

### Use case
What problem does it solve, for a developer or a DevOps reviewer?

### Proposed behavior
Canvas interaction, generated HCL, schema/catalog, review flow, or storage, if
you have one in mind.

### Impact on hard rules / compatibility
Does it touch: staying at branch-only, no-Azure-access, schema-driven forms,
module-call generation, generated HCL style/layout, the OpenAPI contract, the DB
schema, or the Entra role mapping?

### Alternatives considered
Workarounds or other designs.
